tasks.title: Document full-coverage configuration
tasks.claim_boundary: Configuration visibility only; no extraction-quality claim.

tasks.title: Enforce full source-chunk coverage
tasks.claim_boundary: Proves source-read coverage, not rule recall.

tasks.title: Re-split oversized chunks with zero dropped bytes
tasks.claim_boundary: Proves zero source-byte loss; overlap duplicates remain a measured risk.

tasks.title: Measure semantic rule recall
tasks.claim_boundary: The deterministic evaluator and a synthetic fixture are complete, but the fixture is contract-only. A real semantic-recall claim remains blocked pending a licensed stratified sample, two independent human annotations, adjudication, and agreement statistics.

tasks.title: Pass complete v2 fields to optimizer prompts
tasks.claim_boundary: Repairs prompt context; does not establish dependency accuracy.

tasks.title: Audit dependency discovery precision and recall
tasks.claim_boundary: The deterministic evaluator and a synthetic fixture are complete, but the fixture is contract-only. A real dependency precision/recall claim remains blocked pending a licensed rule sample, explicit negatives, two independent human annotations, adjudication, and agreement statistics.

tasks.title: Run corpus feature and expressiveness census
tasks.claim_boundary: Bounded local NDA and privacy-policy pilots are retained and explicitly labeled exploratory. They are not a full-corpus estimate; the NDA pilot found contract issues (including invalid predicate operators), the privacy pilot found a 75% boolean/number/enum subset coverage with one string refusal, and neither authorizes freezing the IR subset.

tasks.title: Implement versioned compiler IR and total lowering
tasks.claim_boundary: The dependency-free v1 subset, semantics document, total fail-closed lowering, string predicates, ignored-field ledger, and independent expected-value tests are implemented. Status remains partial because the bounded IR-2 pilot is not a corpus-wide freeze, table policies are unproved, and date/duration/list/other unsupported constructs are explicit refusals.

tasks.title: Implement solver core and hit-policy proof obligations
tasks.claim_boundary: A provider-free bounded enumerator and conservative UNIQUE/ANY/PRIORITY/COLLECT proof records are implemented. Complete finite-domain UNIQUE checks can be proved; open strings, unbounded/real intervals, COLLECT overlap semantics, missing precedence, timeout, and unknown remain non-passes. This is not a complete SMT backend.

tasks.title: Implement Dutch adapter and frozen 58/37 split
tasks.claim_boundary: Pins the upstream population and evaluator-compatible split only; it is not an evaluated benchmark result and does not redistribute upstream artifacts.

tasks.title: Isolate artifact-free query generation from gold
tasks.claim_boundary: The provider-free Python harness stages copied source files and output only, blocks absolute-path file access outside the staging root, and disables network and child processes. A release claim still requires an external container or VM mount/network boundary recorded in the run manifest; this local guard is not a kernel boundary.

tasks.title: Retain runs and label estimators
tasks.claim_boundary: The retention contract requires one record for every expected model/condition/run key, preserves failed/refused observations with reasons, content-addresses completed artifacts, and rejects comparisons that mix best-of-k with mean estimators. It does not claim that any benchmark runs have yet been executed.

tasks.title: Validate content-addressed run bundles and release boundary
tasks.claim_boundary: The bundle contract verifies file size and SHA-256 digests, rejects traversal/symlink escapes, requires retained run and dependency-lock artifacts, and permits release only through an explicit allowlist that excludes raw/gold/local-only/restricted roles. It does not claim that any benchmark bundle has been executed.

tasks.title: Audit released anchor artifacts
tasks.claim_boundary: Confirms release contents at a pinned upstream commit; does not reproduce metrics.

tasks.title: Replay the released anchor evaluator
tasks.claim_boundary: The pinned evaluator replay validates the 1,900-row observation grid and reports a semantic mismatch in 792 rows; release and replay aggregates are descriptive and do not reproduce or authorize reuse of the historical headline numbers. This is not fresh stochastic replication.

tasks.title: Optionally replicate fresh anchor generations
tasks.claim_boundary: Requires explicit paid-provider authorization and a declared equivalence margin.

tasks.title: Resolve anchor data reuse posture
tasks.claim_boundary: The pinned release's code is identified as CC BY 4.0, while the README's Dutch source-data reuse statement is explicitly only an assumption; therefore the repository records a fail-closed release boundary and does not re-host source, gold, generated, raw, or restricted artifacts. This characterizes posture but is not legal clearance or permission to redistribute.

tasks.title: Validate v2-to-IR lowering against an independent oracle
tasks.claim_boundary: A frozen provider-free fixture contains independent semantic projections and six mutation cases; all five cases pass and all six mutations are killed. This is a fixture-only lowering gate, not a corpus-level accuracy estimate or a substitute for backend equivalence.

tasks.title: Implement bounded reference evaluator
tasks.claim_boundary: A provider-free reference evaluator for Kleene formulas, exceptions, assignments, UNIQUE/ANY dispatch, and fail-closed proof gating is implemented. COLLECT, priority, contextual scope metadata, and unproved/unknown tables remain non-executable; this is reference IR semantics, not source correctness or a complete FEEL engine.

tasks.title: Emit and validate DMN 1.3
tasks.claim_boundary: A dependency-free DMN 1.3 XML emitter and structural validator support proven bounded UNIQUE/ANY tables with conjunctional atomic conditions. Unproved policies, contextual scope, exceptions, derived inputs, and unsupported conditions refuse emission. XML shape is not XSD or semantic equivalence; BE-4 remains required.

tasks.title: Implement bounded SMT-shaped backend and witness queries
tasks.claim_boundary: Provider-free bounded satisfiability, overlap, coverage, conflict, counterexample, and witness query APIs are implemented. Complete finite-domain results can be proved and concrete witnesses are retained; open or unbounded domains, Kleene-unknown coverage, and search limits remain unknown or timeout. This is not a complete SMT backend without a solver dependency.

tasks.title: Cross-check through a pinned third-party DMN engine
tasks.claim_boundary: A deterministic JSONL adapter protocol, provenance requirements, and fail-closed comparison harness are implemented. Missing engines, protocol failures, timeouts, and disagreements remain explicit non-claims; no third-party engine agreement is reported until an approved pinned engine job supplies its metadata and output.

tasks.title: Regression-test restricted P3-prime comparison
tasks.claim_boundary: Comparison theorem for two known tables; never a certificate against an unknown reference.

tasks.title: Evaluate our compiled artifacts in the anchor executor
tasks.claim_boundary: Raw text has no published OE comparator; gold-I/O conditions are labeled gold-leaking.

tasks.title: Choose exception semantics empirically
tasks.claim_boundary: Exception default is unset until this comparison completes.

tasks.title: Freeze estimand and power analysis
tasks.claim_boundary: Tests H0 rho<=0.3 for the declared lower-bound criterion; no post-hoc population expansion.

tasks.title: Implement model-clustered estimation
tasks.claim_boundary: Run-level table with model-clustered bootstrap; mixed effects is sensitivity analysis only.

tasks.title: Implement AFS, sOE, OE, EY, and conditional CQI
tasks.claim_boundary: AFS has no gold-derived query or label; sOE is explicitly gold-labeled; CQI is never correctness.

tasks.title: Build source-grounded metamorphic artifact-free signals
tasks.claim_boundary: Relations are source-grounded and independently adjudicated; they do not use the candidate or gold artifact.

tasks.title: Run instrument validation with controls
tasks.claim_boundary: Positive, random, stratified, and biased controls required; invalid/underpowered is distinct from low association.

tasks.title: Implement ContractNLI transfer adapter
tasks.claim_boundary: ContractNLI supplies labels/spans and AFS evaluation, not gold-artifact OE.

tasks.title: Implement typed, provenance-bound assumption analysis
tasks.claim_boundary: Checks individual and set-level conclusion laundering; legal admissibility remains blinded human judgment.

tasks.title: Implement and ablate source-preserving counterexample repair
tasks.claim_boundary: Deletion/no-op baselines, source preservation, omission rate, held-out evaluation, and cost are mandatory.

tasks.title: Build independent coverage inventory
tasks.claim_boundary: Inventory is independently authored, completeness-audited, training-only, and absent from held-out evaluation.

tasks.title: Build held-out grounding and behavior signals
tasks.claim_boundary: Self-generated vectors are logged but never rewarded.

tasks.title: Run held-out adversarial reward audit
tasks.claim_boundary: Runs after reward components exist and includes held-out/fuzzed attacks, not four overfit fixtures.

tasks.title: Train and report the complete reward frontier
tasks.claim_boundary: Requires explicit GPU/provider authorization; every component, Pareto front, size, reuse, and omission rate is reported.

tasks.title: Freeze and validate publication artifacts
tasks.claim_boundary: Every headline value traces to a valid bundle and is labeled implemented, run, valid, exploratory, refused, or unrun.
